name: a heron standing very still
description: A grey heron stands exactly where the chair was, folded up on one leg, neck kinked back, holding a stillness so complete that you keep checking whether it is real.
looks: Every feather is lying exactly where it was put. The eye is yellow and entirely without sympathy.
The one visible leg is thin as a rail and jointed the wrong way, and it is not shaking at all.
It has not blinked. You have blinked eleven times.
says: I can stand here longer than you can watch.
There is water under this building. I can hear it.
emotes: {it} unfolds its neck to full length, holds it, and folds it back.
{it} takes one enormous slow step and is somehow not any nearer.
{it} opens its wings halfway, the room is briefly much smaller, and closes them.
{it} turns its head so one yellow eye has you entirely.
asks: Is there water in this building?
Are you going to move, or shall I?
What is under the floor here?
